lines: TIMOTHY GUY MITCHELL, role unknown, is selling 208,700 shares in the offer for sale, bringing in proceeds.
Proceeds of up to ₹14.61 crore are scheduled on or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
The event was 23 days ago and is recent; the offer price is shown, and employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so proceeds are slightly lower.
Gain and retained holding are unknown: average cost of acquisition and pre-offer holding are not confirmed from the documents.
